messages:
Samira: Hi all, I accepted the org invite but I can't see the rw-sdk repo in private repos. Help?
Devon: did you accept on your work account or personal?
Samira: I accepted on samira.dev@gmail.com (oops). Thought that was my work email.
Onboarding Bot: Invitation accepted by samira-dev at 2025-01-08 11:12 UTC. Added to team: rw-sdk (pending SSO).
Priya (IT): We usually invite the company account. I'll revoke and resend to samira@redwood.com. Do you have 2FA on the work account?
Samira: I'll enable 2FA now. I do have the work account.
Priya (IT): Revoked old invite and sent new one to samira@redwood.com. Accept that, then authorize SSO and add your SSH key if needed.
Onboarding Bot: Admin action: invite revoked for samira-dev at 2025-01-08 11:15 UTC; new invite sent to samira@redwood.com at 2025-01-08 11:16 UTC.
Samira: Accepted work invite and authorized SSO. I can now see rw-sdk and cloned fine. Thanks!
Devon: welcome aboard! Note for onboarding doc: accept invites on company account + authorize SSO + check Organizations page for team membership.
Priya (IT): I'll add that to the checklist and include steps to recover if you accepted with the wrong account.
Samira: great, thanks everyone.
